subject: ela
intro: Seventh graders determine a theme or central idea of a text and analyze its development over the course of the text. They provide an objective summary, a brief retelling of the key events and ideas without personal opinions or judgments. A theme develops gradually through characters' choices and events.

items.prompt:
Read.

At first, Kim refused to accept help, insisting she could do it alone. After failing twice, she finally asked her teammates, and together they succeeded.

What theme develops across this passage?

steps: I trace how the idea changes.
Kim goes from refusing help to accepting it and then succeeding.
So the theme is that accepting help from others leads to success (the value of teamwork).
solution.answer: Accepting help and working together leads to success.

items.prompt: Which is an OBJECTIVE summary of the passage?

steps: An objective summary states key events without opinion.
So: 'Kim first refused help and failed, then accepted her teammates' help and succeeded.'
solution.answer: Kim first refused help and failed, then accepted help and succeeded.

items.prompt: An objective summary leaves out your personal ____.

Read.

The miser hoarded gold his whole life and died alone and unmourned.

Theme?
A theme develops gradually through events and ____.
A brief, opinion-free retelling is an ____ summary.
